about_the_game:
Story                                                                                                                                                       

In  Cygnus-13: Mission Ready you play as Frankie, your average everyday reptile working as a Mission Clerk at the Intergalactic Alliance Headquarters.  Frankie is busy prepping to interview the crew of the starship Cygnus-13. Her job is to assess the crew's preparedness and overall compatibility.  As a bonus, she gets to see her longtime friend (and longtime crush) Kassidy!

Key Features                                                                                                                                          

Meet the Crew:  Meet our diverse cast of characters for our up coming game Cygnus-13! Niall is hardworking and kind, though a bit awkward socially - then again, he hasn’t exactly been lonely all his life, either. Keekyne has a bold, outgoing personality that - almost - everyone can get along with. RGB are three separate physical beings, but as part of a hivemind, they are legion - or are they? And M1NG, the medical robot, can help heal your wounds… but what else are they capable of?

Uncover the Truth:  When Frankie discovers something strange going on at IA Headquarters she is unsure of what to do. Can she uncover the truth without upsetting everything she's built in her new life?
